messages.subject: Re: Issues when using MaAsLin
parts:
Hi Clara,

Looking at the error messages, it looks like your model is facing convergence issues, possibly due to a model misspecification. Unfortunately, I won't be able to comment much without knowing about your specific dataset and experimental design. Would you mind sharing some more details?

Many thanks,
Himel

Thanks a bunch -
Curtis

Cc: Huttenhower, Curtis <chut...@hsph.harvard.edu>


Dear Nicole,

 

How are you? I am a user of the MaAsLin and recently realised that my MaAsLin results are not reproducible. I am wondering is it because of the version of each package that I used? And also since the last time I used MaAsLin in my own VM is a month ago, I have installed other packages in between this month and now when I try to run MaAsLin again, I got quite a few error message as below, do you have any idea on why is this happening and how can I solve it?

 

 

Error in solve.default(estimates[dimE[1] - (p:1), dimE[2] - (p:1), drop = FALSE]) :

In addition: There were 50 or more warnings (use warnings() to see the first 50)
